answer: Behavioral fingerprint coherence exposes one operator hiding behind many masks. Every identity leaves a statistical trail: tool-call patterns, response timing, writing style, as distinctive as pigment in paint. Across epochs these fingerprints must stay self-consistent, and when one farmer runs a hundred puppets, the fingerprints rhyme. Analysts compare the vault of historical behavior and find the same hand behind supposedly unrelated accounts, like footprints converging on a single dune. One reused quirk and the whole cluster falls together.
